# Teachers Pay Teachers

> > Teachers Pay Teachers is a digital marketplace where educators discover, share, and purchase classroom resources including lesson plans, worksheets, and teaching materials across all grade levels and subjects.

Teachers Pay Teachers (TPT) is the leading online marketplace for PreK-12 educational resources, connecting millions of teachers with high-quality, classroom-tested teaching materials. The platform enables educators to browse curated content by grade level and subject, purchase digital resources with instant delivery, and gift educational materials to colleagues.

## Resource Discovery & Browsing

- [All Resources | TPT](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/browse): Browse and discover educational resources across subjects and grade levels on TPT marketplace.

## Gift Cards & Purchasing

- [TPT Gift Cards](https://www.teacherspayteachers.com/Gift-Card): Purchase digital gift cards for Teachers Pay Teachers resources with instant delivery.
